# .curaprofile fixture (PRF-111)

Test data only; not shipped (`files` in package.json lists `dist`, `LICENSE` and `README.md`, not `test`).

`jeremy_petg_06_super_fast.curaprofile`: copied unmodified from
`blakadder/sv06@6cb99184fac2e867b41fbadf26a07c25354617e1:docs/files/jeremy_petg_06_super_fast.curaprofile`
(committed 2023-04-14 by the repository owner, "add slicer configs and additional info";
https://github.com/blakadder/sv06). sha256 `0c3cca4e95d06a39ec42a7090464d9ba47cb96a1c8cc86fc8b7c0060c29f5ea5`,
1455 bytes. Saved by Cura with `setting_version = 20`, which is Cura 5.0 to 5.2
(`Cura@5bea2f8:plugins/VersionUpgrade/VersionUpgrade413to50/__init__.py:21` moves 19 to 20,
`VersionUpgrade52to53/__init__.py:22` moves 20 to 21). The layout is written down in
`../../../docs/spikes/curaprofile.md`.
